note: Shapes of the project's secrets: character class and length per part, separators and a minimum Shannon entropy. NO value is stored. Regenerate with `npm run scan:calibrate` after a secret changes its format. `allow` entries (kept by --calibrate) exempt ONE obviously fake sample in ONE file; each needs a reason.

allow.reason: Synthetic sample of the hygiene scanner's self-test: a counting sequence that merely has the length and entropy of a client id. The regex is written with a character class so that its own text does not have the shape it exempts.
